criteria.text: User Action: User navigates to their personal chore history. Expected System Behavior: Displays a list of chores assigned to the user, including chore names, creation dates, due dates, completion statuses, and completion dates when applicable.
User Action: User selects a specific chore from their history. Expected System Behavior: Displays additional details about the chore.
User Action: User filters or sorts their chore history by date or completion status. Expected System Behavior: The system updates the displayed list to match the selected filters.
Error Condition: The user has no chore history. Expected message: "No chore history."
Error Condition: The chore history fails to load. Expected message: The system displays an error message and provides an option to retry loading the history.
Error Condition: A chore has been deleted or is no longer available. Expected message: "Chore no longer available."
